craft_notes: Sthāyin: fierce-gaze litany (skeleton/anger/licking/sky — the intensity-doors named in one breath). Rows: row 1 (four-doors uncut). Rupture: colon after going — doors, then time. Close: shines (#3 — even HERE the verb shines: the point of the litany). Rejected: reordering the doors — killed: Sanskrit order kept; moralizing fear — killed: doors listed flat.

lines: By skeleton, angry, licking Bhairavī, sky-going:
at gaze's time — supreme attainment shines.
l4.sanskrit_cite: karaṅkiṇyā krodhanayā bhairavyā lelihānayā | khecaryā dṛṣṭikāle ca parāvāptiḥ prakāśate

reads_against.argmap: What brings supreme attainment? → Even in those fierce gaze-times, supreme attainment shines.
c1_essence: Skeleton, anger, licking, sky-going: attainment shines.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with vīra undertow (stillness at the edge of intensity)
